name: elevatescan
one_liner: Offline static scanner for instruction-privilege-escalation shapes in agent-consumed content (files, tool-output logs, ingested pages).
problem: Agent harnesses often stitch low-privilege content (tool outputs, user-provided files, ingested pages) into the same prompt context as system-level instructions. Ten pattern shapes (role-marker impersonation, override directives, persistent-goal writes, scheduled-task hijack, elevated-authority claims, tool-output followed by imperative, URL-embedded instructions, hidden markers, code-fence hijack, bare sentinel tokens) reliably promote low-level content to a higher instruction level when they land inside such templates. elevatescan is the pre-flight offline scan.
